item.title: The Greatest Book I Have Ever Read
item.description:
Channel: Daniel Greene Uploaded: 24 February 2026 Views: 117.5K Likes: 5.4K Comments: 884
You can get the book here: https://bookshop.org/a/89948/9780140449266 The Count of Monte Cristo might be the greatest book ever written. Alexandre Dumas created something so perfect, so consuming, and so brutally satisfying that I genuinely feel different after reading it. In this video I'm breaking down why The Count of Monte Cristo deserves to be at the top of every reading list — and why if you haven't read it yet, you should let me convince your ignorant ass to read it with this deep dive.
Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wePSaySDa-k
